artificer.name: EVERYTHING ARCANA
artificer.description:
You can reflavor any of your path talents to actually be the effects of magical gizmos you've created. Toss in some magitech buzzwords that almost make sense, and use them to sound like you know what you're talking about—perfect for baffling the less inventive. You can teach others to use them, though doing so always carries risk. If any of these gizmos is ever lost, you can recreate them with some effort during any downtime.

MAGITECHNOBABBLE: alche - fizzi - clank - spro - mag - whizz + nic - tor - al - con - fuse - matic

psion.name: INSTABILITY
psion.description: Each potent spell pulls at the threads in your mind, making your magic harder to control. You add thorns to all psionic spellcasting based on your instability, tracked by looking at the thorns on the lowest line you have marked. Consider what this progressive unraveling of your psyche looks like.

psion.name: BASTIONS
psion.description:
Within your mind lie bastions of psionic power. As you grow stronger, you break down their walls, unlocking your true potential. These powers take shape as visions, psychic phenomena, and even physical manifestations in the form of ectoplasm—pure essence of creation.

BIODYNAMICS: Altering and enhancing your own body. CLAIRSENTIENCE: Gaining knowledge from the collective unconscious. METACREATION: Creating objects from ectoplasm. PSYCHOKINESIS: Manipulating energy and force. TELEPATHY: Mind-to-mind communication, manipulation, and control. TRANSPOSITION: Movement and manipulation of space.

summoner.name: ASPECTS
summoner.description:
Below are examples of planar creatures and their aspects. Existing talents are listed with a page reference; others are made for that beast. If your summoned eidolon has more aspects than those available, ask your GM about donating the PC's own, adding them to the vassal instead.

Dragon: Eldritch Growth · Unicorn: Healing Hands · Ghost: Otherworldly Form · Shadow: Lurker · Demon: Knowing Gaze · Zombie Swarm: Bulwark · Pixie: Arcane Training · Warrior Spirit: Guardian · Air Elemental: Windcaller · Treant: Primal Growth · Oozeling: Shift Form · Tentacles: Fearsome

summoner.name: BUILD-A-VASSAL
summoner.description:
Your summons are from a different plane—a different reality, and their form shifts and shapes to conform to the material plane. Use the crucible below to discover the basic form of your vassal.

It's a squat · gangly · robust · lithe · sleek · imposing -like creature that I send prowl · glide · slither · dash · leap · skitter · crawl · lumber · gallop · floating toward my enemies.

swashbuckler.name: PAST ENTANGLEMENTS
swashbuckler.description:
A Swashbuckler is known by their past. Whose life is intertwined with the story of your deeds? Choose 2 people important in your tales by picking 1 from each side and smashing them together, and 1 more vital to your story that you don't know yet.

First: spurned · obsessed · vengeful · treacherous · jealous · mysterious. Second: lifelong · bitter · adoring · innocent · ambitious · secret. Connection: patron · investigator · paramour · mentor · faction · relative · partner · rival · fan · friend · muse · protégé

swashbuckler.name: CREED
swashbuckler.description:
Many thrilling duelists have a code, a rule they never break, a line they will never cross, or a proverb they live their life by. How devoted to it are you? Choose up to 2 below, or create your own.

all's fair in love and war · wield the sword of justice · accept every challenge · never kill the helpless · coin is meant to be spent · infamous is still famous · gentleman even in dire times · honor is only for the dead · a good story beats any reward · death before dishonor · the best plan is no plan at all · only a fair fight measures skill

witch.name: AFFLICTIONS
witch.description:
Witches are odd and mysterious spellcasters, some with strange maladies. This affliction is something you've grown accustomed to, and while it can inflict thorns and introduce tangles, it shouldn't be debilitating. What is your strange affliction and how did you get it? Choose 1 or make up your own.

plagued by your own shadow · empty eye sockets · skeletal body wasting away · special diet, such as only raw meat · haunted by ancestral ghosts · putrid smell that follows everywhere.

witch.name: THE LANGUAGE
witch.description:
The language of the universe is more than words as we know them. Feelings, thoughts, and reagents also form the syllables. Use the crucible below or come up with your own Words of Power to fit your witch.

WORDS OF POWER: spirit · grace · wither · path · star · color · wall · sleep · fire · gate · storm · wind · absorb · pain · adapt · break · dream · sun · ward · luck · shape · reduce · compel · silence · might · vigor · vex · open · obscure · cloud · blood · grave · time · move · ask · ice · read · puzzle · call · lost · plant · life · reveal · guide · shackle · bind · sea · hunt · secret · stone · trick · voice · growth · travel · message · fable · speak · kindred · weather · beast · memory · know · aid · sanctum · food · instinct · light · truth · rebuke · blend · bird · poison
